name: Limited-Speed Motorcycle
description: A motorcycle with a top speed of 70 km/h or less, handlebars steering one wheel, a seat at least 650 mm high and no enclosure around the rider; an electric moped or scooter certified for the road within that speed is one. It is licensed and equipped as a motorcycle, but never carries a passenger.

restrictions.rule: Handlebars that steer only one wheel, a maximum speed of 70 km/h or less, an unladen seat height of at least 650 mm, and no structure enclosing the rider
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3; Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: Has no class of its own under the Motor Vehicle Act, whose motorcycle must be able to hold 70 km/h laden
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 2(ac)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 or 6N licence, or a licence of another class with a motorcycle endorsement; the motorcycle learner endorsement requires age 16 and a licence of another class
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, N.S. Reg. 226/2026, ss. 3 and 10; Driver Licensing Requirements Regulations, N.S. Reg. 236/2026, s. 28

restrictions.rule: The rider must wear an approved motorcycle helmet certified to BSI, Snell, US DOT or ECE standards, fastened under the chin
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 112, 115 and 116
Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, s. 112(2)

restrictions.rule: Registered and insured to be driven on a highway
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2025, c. 20, ss. 115 and 149

restrictions.rule: One faster than 70 km/h is a full motorcycle
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)
